createBlankDocx.description: Creates a valid empty DOCX without touching the filesystem.

executeDocxAcceptRevision.description: Accept one supported insertion or deletion using its fresh inspect_tracked_changes handle. Keeps inserted content or removes deleted content. For replacement, decide both records individually and re-inspect after each successful decision. Complex revisions are unsupported.

executeDocxAddComment.description: Attach a standard Word comment to exact text in one ordinary body paragraph, including simple formatted runs. Author is explicit; the client supplies current UTC when date is omitted. Wrappers, fields, revisions, cross-paragraph ranges, and threaded comments are unsupported.

occurrence.description: Zero-based occurrence among matching targets. Same convention as find.matches[].occurrence and inspect paragraphs.targetOccurrence / tables.occurrence. Omit when the match is unique.

date.description: Explicit ISO timestamp. The engine-client supplies the current time when omitted.

executeDocxCreateStyle.description: Create a reusable real Word paragraph or character style. No default-style authoring. basedOn and next use IDs; apply paragraph styles with set_paragraph_style using the display name.

styleId.description: Stable Word style ID, for example OpenSuiteReportHeading

name.description: Unique display name; apply paragraph styles using this name

basedOn.description: Existing parent style ID, for example Heading1

clear.description: Remove declarations and restore inheritance. Omitted fields stay unchanged. Twips: 20 = 1 pt.

value.description: Auto uses 240 units per line; exact/atLeast use twips (20 per point).

keepWithNext.description: Keep this paragraph with the following paragraph.

keepLines.description: Keep all lines of this paragraph on one page.

executeDocxCreateTable.description: Create a table at a paragraph placement.

kind.description: start/end need no handle; before/after need an inspected body_blocks handle.

handle.description: Omit for start/end. Required for before/after; copy from the latest relevant document.inspect.

placement.description: Use start/end without a handle at document boundaries, including initial content in a blank document (which has no handles). For before/after, use only a handle from the latest relevant document.inspect; never invent one. Formatting preserves handles within one model turn; handles expire before the next model turn or after other edits.

executeDocxDeleteComment.description: Delete a standard comment and its markers using a fresh inspect_comments handle, preserving the selected document text. Inspect again after every edit.

executeDocxDeleteNote.description: Delete an ordinary simple footnote/endnote and its body reference using a fresh inspect_notes handle. Remaining IDs are preserved. Protected references and complex/malformed notes refuse. Re-inspect after every mutation.
